breaking.change: Removed the proprietary image crop property; it is no longer accepted.
breaking.fix: Use object-view-box: inset(top right bottom left), with percentages v0*100, (1-u1)*100, (1-v1)*100, u0*100. The shipped minimap uses the standard property.

breaking.change: Removed the proprietary list marker properties and the internal --og-list-style-* custom-property channel.
breaking.fix: Use inherited list-style-type, list-style-position and list-style-image. Only list items draw inherited markers.

breaking.change: Removed the proprietary centering and anchoring declarations and their reflected attributes; no aliases remain.
breaking.fix: Center with left/top: 50% and translate: -50%, or standard flex/grid alignment. Use anchor-name, position-anchor and anchor() with translation for asymmetric self-alignment. Existing rotate and scale still compose with translation. Implicit popover anchoring is unchanged.

breaking.change: Removed implicit scene ink and separation shadow styling.
breaking.fix: Declare color and text-shadow. The shipped shooter controls use text-shadow: 0 max(1px, 0.04em) max(1px, 0.08em) #000000, with their scene ink declared as color. Font-relative shadow lengths now use the element's winning font size rather than the body default.

breaking.change: Removed the proprietary skew declaration and skew-x/skew-y reflected attributes without aliases.
breaking.fix: Use transform: skew(x, y). To preserve a legacy rotation/skew/nonuniform-scale combination, move rotation and scale into the same transform list in rotate(...) skew(...) scale(...) order. Animate transform instead of -og-skew.
